description: Size-weighted (arithmetic) average entry price across multiple forex fills. Edge cases: at least 1 fill; every price and units above zero; pair is BASE/QUOTE with two different ISO 4217 codes (a metal such as XAU/USD is accepted here because no pip is needed). The average is weighted by units, not by cash. Not covered: swap, commission, spread, fills in different pairs, and closing fills (buys only). Use when user asks "what's my average entry after these fills?". Returns: totalUnits, totalCost, avgEntry.

fills.description: Fills to average, each with a price and a size in base-currency units

pair.description: Currency pair in BASE/QUOTE format, e.g. "EUR/USD"

name: workflow.run_forex_average_entry
title: Forex Average Entry
